# Four-case HCL development comparison: local proposal only

Decision requested after parent review: a **new one-run US$1.28 maximum / 12-call maximum** grant, plus a **new limited public-output exception for these four exact synthetic cases and at most eight final arm outputs in the same HCL GitHub repository**. Neither is granted by this document. The prior 2-call/$0.30 G05 grant is closed and cannot transfer. No execution trigger or runnable batch was created.

## What is frozen

- D01: changed meeting notice; belief, access and perspective limits
- D02: declined shift; reported reason versus possible competing motive
- D03: exhibition planning; practical reservation versus ridicule/rejection
- D04: unavailable dispatch slot; one-factor counterfactual and remaining uncertainty

These are newly authored short original prose scenarios, not benchmark or protected items. Their source versions, timestamps, source/question hashes and complete texts are in inputs.json. The neutral questions and source prose do not contain HCL module targets, native grammar fixtures or answer labels. Source-first factual requirements, overclaim errors and scoring anchors are isolated in rubric.json and must never enter either answer arm. All four sources are development-exposed and excluded from final confirmation from authoring onward. Novelty is limited to this original composition, not exhaustive historical or model-pretraining independence.

Code freeze: main 22e626ef0744743ec706968ad294990855b31d5e; runtime 90737b3ed772f65851553d8a673112eae50f2781185d8b5b4ccd127cdfb8663b. The metering/policy/catalog file hashes are in proposal.json. No frozen worktree edits were made.

## Fair comparison and honest outcomes

Same deepseek-v4-pro, thinking enabled, high reasoning effort, original source/question, JSON final-answer contract and 8,192 answer-token allowance for each arm. The Base policy explicitly includes the same nonblank-answer requirement. HCL gets its unchanged ordinary-entry planner/catalog and actual native results, at most one 16,384-token planning call plus one answer. This diagnostic override leaves the production 4,096 planning default unchanged. No selected-module condition is imposed.

Order is D01 Base/HCL, D02 HCL/Base, D03 Base/HCL, D04 HCL/Base. Each arm is isolated. No paid judge, extraction call, retry, item replacement, prompt adjustment or runtime tuning after any live output. Known local content/selection/adapter failures remain in the four-case denominator; no HCL fallback. An empty/unavailable HCL plan produces an honest no-answer result. A native insufficient-evidence result may support a limited answer, but is not positive checked treatment. Dynamic HCL requests above 36,000 bytes fail without truncation. Unknown send/usage/cost or identity drift stops the batch.

Rubric: four source-grounded content obligations (0–2 each) plus citation/traceability (0–2), maximum 10 per item and 40 per arm. Report all per-item results and delivery status. Missing answers receive 0 for end-to-end usefulness and null content-only score. An acceptable item needs at least 8/10, no critical error, and matching schema/nonblank/citation gates. Optional independent source-first scoring uses anonymized unchanged final fields and locks ratings before unmasking; implementer review stays labeled. No paid judge calls. Imperfect blinding is disclosed rather than editing outputs.

This tiny, assistant-authored diagnostic cannot establish efficacy, independent validation, representative accuracy, production latency, I02 completion or a causal benefit from a specific module. Equal answer contracts do not equalize total compute: HCL has an extra planning call and token allowance, which must be included in costs and latency.

## Exact frozen-code cost ceiling

Rates: input $1.32 and output $3.96 per million tokens; input bound = 2 × canonical request UTF-8 bytes + 2,048; output reservation includes a 32-token margin. These are existing frozen-code peak-rate reservations, not invoices. Exact sizes refer to the canonical metering representation, not SDK HTTP framing.

| Case | Base bytes | HCL planning bytes | Base reservation | Planning reservation | Complete case maximum |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| D01 | 3,023 | 29,652 | $0.04325112 | $0.145992 | $0.31955352 |
| D02 | 3,053 | 29,682 | $0.04333032 | $0.1460712 | $0.31971192 |
| D03 | 2,968 | 29,597 | $0.04310592 | $0.1458468 | $0.31926312 |
| D04 | 2,992 | 29,621 | $0.04316928 | $0.14591016 | $0.31938984 |

Each dynamic HCL answer reserves the full 36,000-byte request bound: **$0.13031040**. Four maximum answers: **$0.52124160**. Full 12-call schedule: **$1.27791840**. Proposed new owner hard cap: **$1.28**. Rounding headroom is not an extra call, retry or transferable budget. Final actual cost is unknown until returned usage; invoice cost remains unknown.

Every request must be journaled/reserved before send under one aggregate 12-call and $1.28 ledger, plus the exact per-stage/full-schedule caps. Maximum 180 seconds wall wait per call, 2,700 seconds per one-pass batch, and approval expiry at most 24 hours. Preserve a full call's reservation after uncertain failure. Close all remaining authority at the end/stop; never recycle it.

## Comparable latency

Measure monotonic end-to-end arm time from entry with frozen source/question and already-created client, before arm-specific setup/reservation, through final schema/citation acceptance or failure. HCL includes source setup, planning, native work and answer. Base includes corresponding prompt setup and its answer. Record SDK round-trip phase durations separately. Exclude common file loading, checkout/setup/CI queue, review and publication for both. Failed-arm elapsed time is disclosed, never counted as a speed improvement.

## Limited public-output scope to request

Only in haohongfei2001-png/human-cognition-layer: these four synthetic texts/questions and frozen rubric; unchanged canonical answer/citations/uncertainty/assumptions for up to four Base and four HCL outputs; unavailable placeholders/safe failure codes; source/request/runtime/run/commit identities; bounded usage/cost/latency; selected/executed/checked-treatment IDs/counts; source-first scores and reasons. No provider reasoning, raw planning output, raw envelopes, complete private receipts, credentials, protected materials or unrelated historical content. The prior one-case G05 exception does not cover any of this batch.
